dedupe_keys.name: powerdata synthetic european transmission grid time series

description: HES-SO Valais-Wallis researchers publish PowerData as a synthetic European transmission-grid benchmark for machine learning and power-system studies. The deposit supplies a PowerModels JSON network with 4,097 buses, 815 generators, 7,822 lines and 553 transformers, together with CSV load, generation and flow series. Twenty synthetic years use reference labels from 2016–2020, each containing 8,736 hourly steps over a 364-day year. Files are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. The benchmark can test network-flow, dispatch and failure-analysis methods in tools such as model-powermodels-jl or model-pandapower. A caveat is that the time series are generated, not historical operating records, and their periodic 52-week structure differs from calendar years. Matching load, generator and line labels must be used together. The own documentation also specifies a 100 MW per-unit base, which must be retained during conversion. No network or series payload was downloaded.
